name: Paramount Marauder / Arlan
origin: South Africa (licence production in Kazakhstan and Azerbaijan)
armament: 12.7 mm or 7.62 mm MG on ring mount or RWS
protection: Double monocoque V-hull, STANAG 4569 Level III ballistic, 3a/3b mine. Game: immune to small-calibre (5.56/5.45/7.62x39/7.62x51); 7.62x54R AP and larger can penetrate side/rear and disable tyres/engine; every launcher in the game list penetrates.
visual_notes: Tall angular monocoque MRAP body with steeply sloped flat panels and a high V-hull
4x4 (Marauder/Arlan) or 6x6 (Matador) with big single tyres; rear spare wheel
Small trapezoid armoured windows, rear door, roof weapon ring
Arlan is winterised and painted Kazakh green; Azerbaijani Matador/Marauder in desert-green
